address: Rua Peixoto Gomide 1492, São Paulo, 01409-002, Brazil
bio: In this restaurant inspired by the typical cuisine of the Rio Grande do Sul region, chef Tuca Mezzomo masterfully leads his team and immerses himself in the art of preparing grilled and flame-cooked dishes with a continual focus on the best and freshest ingredients. Dishes that you won’t want to miss include the toasted shrimp with sichuran and herbs, and the succulent grilled Wagyu flank, which can be accompanied by Eggplant with goat's curd and dukkah. In addition, the restaurant also produces its own delicious sausages, butter and fresh goat’s cheese. The backdrop to the dining experience is a rustic, welcoming mix of exposed brickwork, wooden tables and subdued lighting that adds to the pleasant ambience....
